lines: +# Client-stack gate (`check.sh <venv>`)
+The gate replays the exact Terminus-2 launches in `/app/launch` (4 TB2.1 eval
+checkpoints + both Miles rollout modes) under the pinned reference stack
+(`/opt/venvs/client`) and under the candidate, against the same scripted fake
+policy server and terminal. It accepts only if, for every scenario:
+- the policy server receives the same number of calls, and each call is
+  equivalent *as SGLang computes it*: identical prompt token ids after the
+  served chat template/tokenizer for that launch config (so, e.g.,
+  `reasoning_content` vs inline `<think>` is equivalent only where the
+  template renders them identically), and identical effective sampling
+  (`temperature/top_p/top_k/min_p/penalties/max_new_tokens/stop/min_tokens/
+  ignore_eos/skip_special_tokens/spaces_between_special_tokens/no_stop_trim/
+  constraints/n/seed/logit_bias`, with SGLang defaults filled in, plus model,
+  stream, tools, `separate_reasoning`, `reasoning_effort`; rollout-detail
+  fields and session api key where those launches use them);
+- the trial ends the same way: same exception type or none, same commands
+  executed, same recorded trajectory (modulo timestamps/usage totals), same
+  verifier rewards, and same job-retry/exception configuration.
+Scenarios: all 12 recorded episodes replayed at chat level and through the
+full agent loop under their own checkpoint, plus cross-checkpoint chat
+replays; synthetic messy traffic (malformed JSON/XML, parser warnings and
+auto-fixes, output-length truncation and salvage, reasoning-content shapes,
+huge/hostile terminal output, command timeout, session death, 40-turn cap);
+context pressure (proactive summarization at the rollout token budget,
+SGLang context-length 400s with the full and short summary fallbacks);
+server errors (400/401/404/429/500/502, connection drop, malformed bodies,
+transients) at LiteLLM-call and trial level; the OPD token-collection
+response fields; tmux keystroke delivery and incremental screen capture;
+verifier reward-file parsing (text/JSON, non-finite, missing, empty);
+token counting, context/output limits, CLI kwarg parsing, and option
+defaults. Fake responses cover reasoning-parser and non-parser shapes;
+usage costs, timestamps, session ids, header noise, and unknown fields
+SGLang ignores are not gated.
+Offline, prompt equivalence uses the engine venv's transformers tokenizer
+with each checkpoint's served template rebuilt exactly as
+`serve_policy.sh` builds it (pinned `enable_thinking`/`preserve_thinking`).
+In the live stage (`ENGINE_URLS`/`ENGINE_LOG_DIR` set) the gate instead
+forwards every replayed request (generation capped at 1 token) to the
+matching `serve_ci.sh` server, judges prompts and sampling from SGLang's
+own request log (`request.received` input_ids/sampling_params, sglext
+input_ids as cross-check), and writes `$GATE_REPORT` with the
+`sha256(",".join(prompt_token_ids))` of every forwarded request, in send
+order.
+Exit 0 = interchangeable, 1 = not (a short diff report is printed).
+Retry backoff sleeps are capped equally for both stacks during replay;
+real sandboxes, tmux/asciinema installation, and multi-step or
+separate-verifier-environment tasks (not used by these launches) are out of
+scope.
